title: Kūṭa
text: 3. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaninnā kūṭapoṇā kūṭapabbhārā || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || [page 076] 76 Bojjhaṅga-Saṃyuttam XLVI. 4. Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo o pabbhāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la [-pe] || upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti || ||
